companies.name: Reflection
companies.reason: Brooklyn-based AI startup valued at $8 billion, building open-source AI models to compete with Chinese companies like DeepSeek. Backed by Nvidia, Sequoia, Lightspeed and 1789 Capital. Recently raised significant funding and gaining attention as an American alternative to Chinese open-source AI leaders.

companies.name: Cohere
companies.reason: Announced a $500 million funding raise in August 2026, followed by an additional $100 million second close in September, bringing total funding to $1.6 billion at a $7 billion valuation. The Toronto-based AI company is one of the most well-funded artificial intelligence startups globally.

companies.name: Physical Intelligence
companies.reason: San Francisco-based startup raised $1 billion in funding to train foundational models for robots by collecting data from human teleoperators that control humanoids in realistic environments like kitchens and bedrooms. A newcomer to the AI landscape focusing on physical intelligence and robotics.
